Source: every knowledge fact in parts C and C2 cites exactly one physical page of the private snapshot of the Washington Driver Guide, the issuer's own publication, read from extracted page text.
Confidence: high for the focus, vision, night, curve, ice, skid and hydroplane facts, each restated from one explicit sentence or numbered step; nothing was taken from memory, from a non-issuer source, or from the illustrations.
Precision rule: the usual headlight reach at night and the ordered skid and hydroplane steps are kept exactly as printed inside cited fact blocks in C and C2, with the wording paraphrased so that no learner line copies the guide.
Accuracy flags: the headlight reach figure is printed as a usual value, not a fixed rule, and is kept with that qualifier; the first page of the range opens with the end of the previous section's turning-gap topic, used for one fact only; the vision and curve illustrations were not read (verify — sec13-D-FLAG).
Stability: the guide is a single published revision and states it may lag new legislation, so any rule that a future law changes must be re-read from the current edition before reuse.
External review: no clinical or legal review is required; the content restates published licensing and traffic rules for exam preparation only.
